Class InlineToolkit

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.InlineToolkit
public final class InlineToolkit extends Object
DSL factory for inline-specific elements.

This class provides static factory methods for elements designed for inline display mode (non-alternate-screen rendering). Use these alongside the general-purpose methods in Toolkit. 

import static dev.tamboui.toolkit.InlineToolkit.*;
import static dev.tamboui.toolkit.Toolkit.*;

Element ui = column(
    text("Status: downloading").cyan(),
    scope(downloading,
        row(text("file1.zip: "), gauge(progress[0])),
        row(text("file2.zip: "), gauge(progress[1]))
    ),
    text("Footer").dim()
);

    • scope

      public static InlineScopeElement scope(Element... children)
      Creates an inline scope element with the given children.

      A scope is a container that can be shown or hidden dynamically. When hidden, it collapses to zero height. 

      scope(
    row(text("file1.zip: "), gauge(progress[0])),
    row(text("file2.zip: "), gauge(progress[1]))
).visible(downloading)
      Parameters:
      children - the child elements
      Returns:
      a new scope element
